findings.detail: The source principal cell includes a euro currency marker; the principal amount should be normalized as 13,809 with the EUR marker separated rather than retained in the numeric principal field.

rationale: Class 1 single-cell format adjudication. The schedule's Par/Shares/Units column for Singular Bank / Pluto Holdco Limited is the source row carrying a foreign-currency principal marker: EUR 13,809. A numeric principal amount field should not retain the currency marker, so the weak fmt_principal_amount flag is a real extraction-format defect rather than a false alarm. No aggregate anchor was needed.
